p: I am verily a man which: Paul, making a short declaration of his former life, proves both his calling and doctrine to be from God.

feet of Gamaliel: That is, his daily hearer: the reason of this speech is this: those who teach commonly sit in the higher place, speaking to their students who sit upon benches beneath, and therefore he says "at the feet of Gamaliel".
slew him: This is properly spoken, for Steven was murdered by a bunch of cutthroats, not by order of justice, but by open force: for at that time the Jews could not put any man to death by law.
And they gave him audience unto: Resolute and stubborn pride will neither embrace the truth itself, neither allow others to receive it.
cried out: The description of a seditious tumult, and of a foolish and mad multitude.

The chief captain commanded him to: The wisdom of the flesh does not consider what is just, but what is profitable, and in addition takes into account the profit that can be gained, according as it presently appears.
And as they bound him with: There is no reason why we may not use those lawful means which God gives us in order to repel or prevent an injury.
a Roman: Not by nation, but by the law of his city of birth.
